review_cost.rationale: Approve after a small, well-localized round: cache eviction, dead dependency, guarded sort lookup, and the home filter form rebuilt on framework primitives.

findings.issue: In-memory cache has a 60 s TTL but never evicts expired entries, and its keys include request-derived URLs (e.g. pokemon-species/<arbitrary name>), so a long-running server grows the map indefinitely; 404 nulls are cached per unique key.
findings.suggestion: Sweep or cap entries on write (small LRU, or delete expired keys when new ones are inserted), or only cache known-good resource URLs.

findings.issue: Filter state lives in DOM refs with hand-rolled debounce, imperative select.value writes and manual navigate calls, where the framework's <Form method="get"> / useSearchParams are the documented primitives; typed text can also be lost if a pagination link is clicked within the debounce window (home.tsx:158,164).
findings.suggestion: Rebuild the form on <Form method="get"> + useSearchParams with controlled values and a debounce wrapper; the pre-hydration replay can be kept as a small effect.

findings.issue: Non-null assertion on columns.find(c => c.key === sort.key) is a latent TypeError if sort state ever outlives the column set (e.g. showLevel changing without a remount).
findings.suggestion: Return rows unsorted when the column is missing, or key sort state to the column list.

findings.issue: ErrorBoundary only logs under import.meta.env.DEV, so production 500s (e.g. upstream API failures) leave no trace.
findings.suggestion: Always log (server-side console for thrown errors), or surface it to an observability hook.

findings.issue: isbot is declared as a dependency but never imported; React Router's built-in server entry handles bot detection.
API endpoint shapes (Move, Species, Pokemon, Ability) are declared inline and duplicated across route modules (pokemon.tsx:40-66 declares a different Move).
findings.suggestion: Move endpoint types into lib/types.ts alongside Card/TypeInfo so there is one definition per resource.

findings.issue: Splat route's component returns null and 404 rendering depends entirely on the loader throwing to the root ErrorBoundary; direct navigation to the component would render an empty page if the loader ever changed.
findings.suggestion: Render the not-found UI in the splat component (or rely on the root boundary alone) rather than a null component.

findings.issue: Every Pokémon page pays a version-group index fan-out (~40 requests) plus one request per move learned in the selected game on cold cache; all are re-fetched every 60 s.
findings.suggestion: Give the version-group index a longer TTL (it is effectively static) and consider caching per (game, method) move tables.

summary: A current, genuinely idiomatic React Router v8 framework-mode app: loaders own URL state, 404s are thrown as data responses, the server/client boundary is clean, and edge cases like pre-hydration input are handled. The main review request is rebuilding the home filter form on <Form method="get">/useSearchParams instead of DOM refs, plus a cache-eviction fix for the request-keyed in-memory cache. I would merge after one small round of localized changes.
